page.overview:
Who is Gohsk?

Gohsk appears in Mortal Kombat: Deception's Konquest Mode as an NPC. He is a stout and thuggish assassin hailing from Outworld, wearing grey and green robes and is always seen wielding a dagger. His name is derived from one of the game's creators: Tony Goskie.
